newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Soda to produce material for 256MB DRAMs.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Soda to produce material for 256MB DRAMs.

text.p: Nippon Soda Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would start commercial production of a material to make photo-resist for 256 megabit dynamic random access memories (DRAMs) in October 1997.
Photo-resist is an essential material for semiconductor production.

The company will invest two to three billion yen in setting up production facilities at one of its subsidiaries in Chiba Prefecture near Tokyo to produce Poly P-Hydroxystyrene, a company spokesman said.
The facilities will be capable of producing 200 tonnes of Poly P-Hydroxystyrene a year initially, the spokesman said.
It will be increased to 300 tonnes if demand grows, he added.
